name: Hayes
source:
Nervous barista Hayes feels more comfortable around coffee and cats than he does around people, but can you reach his heart and help him blossom?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datenighto/hustle-cat-a-visual-novel-about-a-magical-cat-cafe]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]Hayes' magic is voice based. Whatever actions he describes when he reads poetry happen in real life. The quality of the poem doesn't matter so long as Hayes has conviction behind his words.[/spoiler]
